column1: # What a person decided about a seeded row the generator was unsure of.
# HAND-MAINTAINED. GlossSeedMain never writes this file - that is the whole
# reason it is separate from pNNN.flags.tsv, which is regenerated on every run
# and would eat a review kept inside it.
# The key is (codepoint, reading). The kind and doubts columns record WHAT WAS
# REVIEWED, not just that something was: if the generator later raises a
# different problem for the same pair, the workbench shows the verdict as stale
# rather than counting it as done. A verdict that outlives its subject is worse
# than no verdict, because it reads as finished.
#   OK       checked, the seeded gloss stands as it is
#   FIXED    a TSV was edited; the problem is dealt with
#   WONTFIX  reviewed, and there is nothing worth doing
# Three values on purpose. Decision gc4 - "what can a reviewer say about a
# row?" - is open, and a vocabulary invented before anyone has reviewed a
# partition would be guessing at the categories.
